ritual.new: A quiet beginning: write down one intention for the month and do not rush it.
ritual.waxingCrescent: Take a first small step toward what you have in mind.
ritual.firstQuarter: Time for decisions: remove one obstacle that has been in the way for a while.
ritual.waxingGibbous: Refine and polish; nothing needs a radical change yet.
ritual.full: Sum up the month: what worked, and what you can thank yourself for.
ritual.waningGibbous: Share what you have learned and thank the people near you.
ritual.lastQuarter: Let go of the extra: tasks, thoughts and things you no longer need.
ritual.waningCrescent: Rest and recover. The best thing you can do is get some sleep.
